description: List the axes a recipe search can be narrowed along on BBC Good Food, with the values each one takes and how many recipes carry them. Pass 'query' to measure the counts inside one search, or leave it out for the site's whole listing. Read this before narrowing a search: the site accepts any value on a facet and answers one it does not know with a total of zero, so a guessed spelling comes back as a confident absence. The values listed are an excerpt of the most frequent ones, and the site accepts others that are not shown.

query.description: A search to measure the counts inside. The site counts its facets over the rows a search returns, so a count without a query describes the whole listing instead.

name: list_filters

argument.description: The search_recipes argument that restricts this axis. Null where a search takes none. A value listed here is in the site's units and may need converting before it is passed.

label.description: The site's own wording for the axis.

name.description: The site's own name for the axis.

option_count.description: How many options are listed here, which is not how many the site accepts.

count.description: Recipes carrying the value within this scope. Null when the site published none.

label.description: The site's own wording for the value.

value.description: The value as the site publishes it, in the site's own units.

query.description: The search the counts were measured in, trimmed.

total_available.description: Recipes the site says this scope holds. Null when it published no figure.

total_is_ceiling.description: True when the total sits on the largest number of rows one search will serve, so it states a floor rather than a count.

title: List the ways a search can be narrowed
